title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANT
description: Released in June 2019, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant 'Black Non-Reflective' repackages the adult shoe for infant-sized feet. This edition skips the reflective aspects of the accompanying release, favoring a straight black Primeknit upper with the 350 V2's standard side stripe across the lateral. The shoe includes integrated lacing for a personalized fit and a heel loop. Below, adidas' revolutionary Boost cushioning is contained inside of a translucent TPU midsole.

title: YEEZY 500
description: The Yeezy 500 Super Moon Yellow arrives in a light yellow finish on the suede and mesh upper with a midsole inspired by the adidas ‘Feet You Wear’ technology of the ‘90s. Befitting the shoe’s unique moniker, the original December 2017 launch of the Yeezy 500 ‘Super Moon Yellow’ was wholly unconventional: shoppers were able to get their hands on the kicks only if they purchased a bundled option that also included a hoodie and sweat shorts. A subsequent standalone release followed months later.
